title: Naruto
summary: A spoiler-heavy briefing on Naruto's plot, characters, major deaths, terminology, and fandom conversations.

content.overview: Naruto follows Naruto Uzumaki, an ostracized ninja who carries the Nine-Tailed Fox and wants to become Hokage. The larger story expands from village missions into a conflict over tailed beasts, inherited cycles of violence, and the Fourth Shinobi World War.
quick_brief: Naruto begins as an isolated prankster seeking recognition and ends as a hero accepted by the village.
Team 7 consists of Naruto, Sasuke, Sakura, and their teacher Kakashi.
Sasuke's departure and Naruto's promise to bring him back drive much of the series.
The Akatsuki hunt the tailed beasts, including the Nine-Tails sealed inside Naruto.
The final central conflict is Naruto versus Sasuke after the war.

essential_facts.fact: The story is split between Naruto and the later Naruto: Shippuden era.
Naruto is the jinchuriki of Kurama, the Nine-Tailed Fox.

talking_points.opener: The Pain arc is where Naruto's ideals finally become more important than simply winning fights.
talking_points.follow_up: His conversation with Nagato turns the series' cycle-of-hatred theme into an explicit choice.
talking_points.context: Useful when discussing the strongest story arc rather than only favorite battles.

talking_points.opener: Sasuke is easier to understand as a trauma-driven rival than as a conventional villain.
talking_points.follow_up: Each revelation about Itachi changes what Sasuke thinks justice requires.

vocabulary.meaning: The leader of the Hidden Leaf Village.
vocabulary.example: Naruto's original goal is to become Hokage so the village will recognize him.

vocabulary.meaning: A person who has a tailed beast sealed inside them.
The energy used to perform ninja techniques.

common_mistakes: Do not treat Naruto and Naruto: Shippuden as unrelated shows.
Do not call every eye technique the Sharingan; the Byakugan and Rinnegan are distinct.
Do not describe Itachi's motives without accounting for the later reveal about the Uchiha massacre.

questions.question: Who is Naruto's main rival?
questions.answer: Sasuke Uchiha, his Team 7 teammate and the person Naruto repeatedly tries to bring back to the village.

questions.question: Does Naruto become Hokage?
questions.answer: Yes. He becomes the Seventh Hokage after the main series.

content.premise: A young ninja shunned because of the monster sealed inside him attempts to earn recognition, protect his friends, and eventually lead his village.
content.ending_summary: After Kaguya is defeated and the war ends, Naruto and Sasuke fight one final battle at the Valley of the End. Both lose an arm, Sasuke concedes, and the cycle between their predecessors is broken. Naruto later marries Hinata and eventually becomes the Seventh Hokage.

characters.name: Naruto Uzumaki
characters.role: Protagonist, member of Team 7, and jinchuriki of the Nine-Tails.
characters.fate: Survives, marries Hinata, and becomes the Seventh Hokage.

characters.name: Sasuke Uchiha
characters.role: Naruto's rival and the survivor whose pursuit of revenge drives the central conflict.
characters.fate: Survives the final battle and leaves on a journey of atonement.

characters.name: Jiraiya
characters.role: Legendary Sannin, author, spy, and Naruto's mentor.
characters.fate: Killed while investigating Pain in the Hidden Rain.

major_events.title: Sasuke leaves the village
major_events.description: Sasuke joins Orochimaru in pursuit of enough power to kill Itachi, and Naruto fails to stop him at the Valley of the End.

major_events.title: Jiraiya dies fighting Pain
major_events.description: Jiraiya uncovers the secret behind Pain but is killed before he can return, leaving a coded final message.

fandom_debates: Whether the Pain arc is the series' narrative peak.
How much the reincarnation reveal weakens or supports the story's themes.
Whether Sasuke's decisions remain sympathetic after learning the truth about Itachi.
